interpretation.headline: Frozen test evaluation for baseline 1.1.0 with probability-argmax inference.
interpretation.human_holdout: Ten public human-written prompts provide a small realism check, not a statistically stable product-quality claim.
interpretation.scoring_correction: The first run used SVC.predict; the corrected run uses probability argmax to match baseline.classify. Model hashes and data stayed identical.
interpretation.test_reuse_policy: Do not tune baseline 1.1.x against these errors. Improvements require development data and a newly frozen future test release.
